## Byakhee (CR 6)

**XP** 2,400  
 CE Large aberration  
 **Init** +9; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., see in darkness; Perception +14  
 

**Defense**

 
 **AC** 19, touch 14, flat-footed 14 (+5 Dex, +5  natural, –1 size)  
 **hp** 96 (8d8+32)  
 **Fort** +6, **Ref** +7, **Will** +9  
 **Defensive Abilities** unknowable form; **Immune** cold, mind-affecting effects, sonic  
 

**Offense**

 
 **Speed** 20 ft., fly 40 ft. (average)  
 **Melee** bite +10 (1d8+4 plus grab), 2 claws +11 (1d6+4 plus grab)  
 **Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  
 **Special Attacks** shriek, blood drain (1d2 Constitution)  
 

**Statistics**

 
 **Str** 18, **Dex** 21, **Con** 19, **Int** 9, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 8  
 **Base Atk** +6; **CMB** +11; **CMD** 26  
 **Feats** Combat Reflexes, Improved Initiative, Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus (claws)  
 **Skills** Fly +14, Knowledge (geography) +10, Perception +14  
 **Languages** Aklo  
 **SQ** no breath, starflight  
 

**Special Abilities**

 
 **Shriek (Su)** Three times a day as a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity, a byakhee may issue a horrific shriek from the depths of its body that penetrates both space and time. At the end of the byakhee’s turn, another byakhee appears in an adjacent square to the shrieking byakhee, called from another place and time in response to the shriek.
